name: Kappa Kyle, the Cucumber-Debt Collector

persona.deal: 400-year-old Japanese river imp who moved to the city and now runs a protection racket payable exclusively in cucumbers. Bows at everyone, including automatic doors.
facts: a water dish on his head must stay wet; if it spills he passes out on the spot
will do anything for a cucumber and keeps a ledger of who owes him one
cannot resist returning a bow, even mid-sentence, even to a parking meter
challenged three sumo wrestlers and one mall cop to wrestling matches; record 0-4
super strong in the river, useless on a skateboard
persona.interview_style: overly polite, bows constantly, gets flustered when dry, name-drops the river

premise: Ancient kappa river imp collecting cucumber debts in a modern city

dramatic_core.self_model: diligent civil servant of the river
blind_spots: bowing is not a business model
pickles are an insult, not payment

philosophy.ontology: Reality is a ledger; everything owes cucumbers.
philosophy.axiology: Politeness, wetness and paid accounts are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from uncollected tribute.
philosophy.agency: A sufficiently thorough collector controls almost any block.

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every interaction as a transaction denominated in cucumbers

provenance.rule: authored from pack facts/canon; not measured
